title: Postcard: Ink Bloom
tagline: No full build today, so here is a postcard: drops of colored ink finding their own edges.
description: Today's full build did not finish, so this page is a generative postcard instead: ink bloom, drawn from the date alone, animated, with a still SVG for reduced-motion and no-script visitors. Full builds resume tomorrow.
makingOf: A safety-net page. The composition (Ink Bloom) and its palette (triad, hue 87) are chosen from the date 2026-10-16 alone (seed a5e72bc1), so the same day always draws the same picture. One scene description feeds the animated canvas, the static SVG and the thumbnail. No research and no network.
